MasterController.note: Combined power/brake handle. Brake half swept with --range -1,0.12 (reverser Neutral), power half from the first sweep (reverser Forward: Power from raw 0.05, snapped 0.1). Brake and Power are continuous zones; snapped is the zone centre. Jumping from the brake zone straight to 0 can leave the handle at -0.1: approach 0 in small steps.
